task.speaker: {actor}
task.text: Today's exercise. This loop should add up the n numbers in array a, but it crashes:   for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) sum += a[i];   What is the bug?

options.text: The loop runs one step too far: it should be i < n

wrong.speaker: {actor}
wrong.text: Look at the last value of i. An array of n items goes from index 0 to n − 1.

right.speaker: {actor}
right.text: Exactly: an off-by-one error. Fix it and run the tests… all green. Good work.
